title: Tattoo studio, new business in an existing leased storefront — Aguadilla, zone X inland
description: I am opening a tattoo studio with two tattoo artists in an existing leased storefront in Aguadilla. The space is move-in ready; no construction. We use needles and dispose of sharps.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).
RULE_0160: Ley 318-1999 Art. 10, no tattoo studio may operate without a Departamento de Salud license.
RULE_0696: Ley 318-1999 Arts. 3-6, each tattoo artist needs a Departamento de Salud license.

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction stated: RULE_0643/0644 need a construction / renovation project type.
FEMA zone X: RULE_0706 needs location.flood_zone.sfha.
Pin outside the coastal zone: RULE_0708 needs location.czm.
Commercial use in an existing commercial storefront, no change of use: no consulta trigger.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-05 by the scenario loop: first tattoo-studio scenario and first Aguadilla scenario. Biomedical sharps disposal (RULE_0697, heuristic) is deliberately not asserted.
